headline: Sensex and Nifty Rebound as Banks Lead Gains Amid Foreign Inflows and Mixed Q2 Earnings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows boosting market sentiment
Lower crude oil prices supporting the rally
Rebound in banking stocks leading early trade
Optimism regarding foreign flows in Indian shares
whatHappening: HAL reported a 16% rise in net profit, beating estimates despite an EBITDA miss
Bharat Dynamics shares fell over 6% following a 15% slide in quarterly profit
Gabriel India shares hit a 20% upper circuit on high trading volume
Alkem Laboratories reported a 12% fall in net profit and appointed a new CFO
summary: Indian markets rebounded as Sensex and Nifty gained, driven by foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices. While defense major HAL reported profit growth, Bharat Dynamics saw a sharp decline in earnings and stock price. Gabriel India stood out with a 20% surge, while Alkem Laboratories reported a drop in quarterly profit.
